title: Hostile telepaths encountered on Mars

tellings.quote: If you go to Mars telepathically, the first thing you'll encounter is a group of five telepaths who are not exactly welcoming.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a psychologist who studies psychic abilities, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that if you travel to Mars with your mind alone, using telepathy, the first thing you will meet is a group of five telepaths. He says they are "not exactly welcoming." He offers it as a picture of what people exploring by mind report finding, which would mean other minds are out there if true.
